product.title: Experience the Magic of Andean Textiles: Weaving workshop - Cusco

description.text: In Cusco, this Sacred Valley textile workshop is led by master weavers who demonstrate natural dyeing and loom techniques, then time at the loom for a piece visitors take home. Lunch is served family-style with the artisans, and coffee or herb tea is included. Private transport from Cusco is listed, and the group is capped at five so the day stays on the workshop floor rather than a market shopping loop. Materials are included. The format suits visitors who want a guided Indigenous craft day without finding a workshop independently. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Cusco, and the itinerary stays on the Sacred Valley textile workshop that defines this outing rather than a Pisac ruin circuit or a city walking tour from the plaza.
